name: Mama ga Boku o Amaku Ijimeru Wake
original_name: ママが僕を甘く躾る理由
source:
I love my mother more than anything in the world.
She's so giving. She does anything for me.

Now that I'm in puberty, I've started having wet dreams about her...

One day, those dreams... become real.

[from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ136095.html/?unique_op=af]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
我爱我的母亲胜过世界上的一切。
她是如此的付出。她为我做任何事情。

现在我已经到了青春期，我开始梦到她了……

有一天，那些梦想……成为现实。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ136095.html/?unique_op=af]DLsite English[/url]]
